title: Treasury Regulations (Quy định Kho bạc về thuế)
typeLabel: Quy định / Văn bản dưới luật

versions.text:
Treasury Regulations (26 CFR). Interpretive regulations issued by the Department of the Treasury and IRS implementing the Internal Revenue Code.
Part 1: Income taxes (§1.1-1 through §1.9100).
Part 20: Estate tax.
Part 25: Gift tax.
Part 31: Employment taxes and Collection of Income Tax at Source.
Part 301: Procedure and Administration.
